source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/12-community.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p12"; README screen 12
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell (Sidebar + TopBar) + Masthead + CommunityRooms, real components, populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-community'] — no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md).

Artboard order, content column top to bottom: room tile grid (FIXED 4 columns, 7 rooms + the dashed '+ New vertical group' tile as the grid's own 8th slot) -> the ROOM INDEX card (SectionRule, Anton head '<ROOM> ROOM' with the small-caps aside, the JURIS. / DISCUSSION / REPLIES / LAST ACTIVITY table, the foot strip with 'Start a discussion') -> the NEW POST card. Rail, top to bottom: Who's here, Verifier sign-off, Why post here.

Lane community60 (2026-09-08) closed six listed differences: the extra 'REGIONAL ROOMS' heading above the tiles is gone (the artboard has no such heading; its stat line is the masthead dek); tiles carry the room NAME, not the 3-char key; the stacked discussion feed became the artboard's TABLE, built on the shared RowTable (extended additively with a `metrics` prop for p12's 14px pad / 56px rows / trailing rule, plus per-row `id`/`onActivate`/`below`); the composer left the discussions card and became its own NEW POST card at the foot of the content column; the room header + 'Live in this region' card left its position between the tiles and the discussions for R7 placement after the last designed region; and the rail order is now the artboard's, with the R7 Vertical groups card after it.

R8 holds: the thread PAGE is not built. The table is the room index and a row expands in place (the `#post-<id>` anchor the rail already emitted is now carried by the table row, so those links still resolve).

Absence, logged in DEVIATION-LOG: the artboard's per-row QUESTION / PRACTICE / MARKET / TEMPLATE tag chip has no data path (community_posts, migration 030, has no kind/topic/tag column), so the Absence convention renders in its slot.

UI FIX ROUND 2026-09-08, items A1/A3 (lane cardrule): the rows named 'A1 rule on ...' and 'A3 shell of ...' below measure the card shell the operator ruled belongs to the CARD component. They assert the gradient's exact value, which the earlier rule rows on this page did not; the closing 'CLASS CLOSURE' row is the check that fails if any card on this page renders with no rule at all.

Lane communitynav2 (2026-09-08) applied the operator's amendment to this artboard: the '<ROOM> REGION' card and its 'Live in this region' rows are REMOVED (the thread table supersedes them), so the content column ends at the NEW POST card; and the empty state moved into the room-index card's FOOT beside 'Start a discussion' rather than sitting in the card body. This reverses the R7 placement community60 gave the region card earlier the same day. The card's live join/leave action was not dropped with it: it moved to the composer it gates (DEVIATION-LOG), since without it a member can never join and the composer stays permanently disabled.

forbid.name: CLASS CLOSURE (community): a card element that renders no 3px rule
forbid.reason: Coordinator note N3: 'Prove the class is closed ... a check that fails when a card element renders without it'. Encoded as a FORBID, which is the harness's own form for 'the design does not have this element': every card in the product is `SectionCard` (src/components/ui/SectionCard.tsx), which stamps `data-section-card` on itself and mounts the 3px rule in one of exactly two positions (its first flow child, or inside its own absolutely positioned wrapper when the card carries padding). This selector reaches a card with the rule in NEITHER position, so a match is a ruleless card and the row goes NOT IN SPEC. Ruling 5.2's band-grouping card, the one card that legitimately draws no dark-grey rule, stamps `data-section-card="band-grouping"` instead, so it is outside this selector by identity rather than by being invisible to it.
